# Disallow display of category from other shop

With a multishop installation, you can display the list of products of a category from another store, even if this category is not associated with the current store.  
Just need to know the category ID
ex: https://shop.com/1234-id-cat-other-shop

## Attendu
display a 404 page if the category is not associated with the current shop

## Étapes
1) you have a multisite installation with two shop (ore more)
2) in general context create a category tree 
- root
-- shop 1
--- cat-1
-- shop 2
--- cat-2
3) got to shop 1 assign cat-1 to this shop  
4) got to shop 2 assign cat-2 to this shop  

Get the id of cat-1
Got to front of shop 2, on listing of cat-2, 
change the id of cat-2 with id cat-1   
You will see category of shop-1 on shop-2

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
